articles.title: CVE-2026-130320 — CVSS 9.3
articles.summary: In Open Object Rexx (ooRexx) before 5.2.0, RXAPI mishandles nameArg and userid bounds checking, possibly leading to arbitrary code execution via crafted messages.

articles.title: GHSA: qbee-agent: Docker Compose build context Zip Slip writes outside context directory
articles.summary:
## Summary

`qbee-agent` contains a Zip Slip vulnerability in `app/utils/tar.go`. The tar extractor checks whether an entry remains inside the destination directory with:

```go
strings.HasPrefix(targetPath, destdirClean)
```

This does not enforce a path separator boundary. If the destination directory is `/tmp/.../context`, a tar entry such as `../context-outside/payload.txt` cleans to `/tmp/...

articles.title: GHSA: Silverstripe Framework: RCE via i18nTextCollectorTask writer parameter
articles.summary:
### Impact
The writer option of the i18nTextCollectorTask dev task was passed to the injector without validation. A crafted dev task URL could create arbitrary objects with attacker-controlled constructor arguments and run code on the server. Because the dev task did not ask for confirmation, an administrator could be tricked into running it by following a link. On a site in dev mode, no login was

articles.title: GHSA: Silverstripe Framework: User-controlled ClassName allows unauthorized record type change
articles.summary:
### Impact
A user who can edit a record through a GridField detail form could change the record to an unrelated class, without the permission checks for that class.

### Reported by
Lachlan Davidson, Carapace

articles.title: GHSA: Silverstripe Framework: CMS_ACCESS_SecurityAdmin privilege escalation
articles.summary:
### Impact
A user with access to the Security section (CMS_ACCESS_SecurityAdmin) but without the ADMIN permission could edit a group that grants ADMIN through a role or a parent group, and use it to escalate their own privileges.

### Reported by
Lachlan Davidson, Carapace

articles.title: GHSA: Silverstripe Framework: Auth bypass GridFieldDetailForm
articles.summary:
### Impact
A CMS user who can edit records through a GridField detail form could create new records without the permission to create them, by sending a save request directly.

### Reported by
HDWSec - https://hdwsec.fr

articles.title: GHSA: Silverstripe Framework: XSS via SVG data URI
articles.summary:
### Impact
The HTML sanitiser did not remove SVG data URIs. A CMS author could store content that runs JavaScript in the browser of another user who views it.

### Reported by
HDWSec - https://hdwsec.fr

articles.title: GHSA: Silverstripe Framework: XSS via XHTML data URI
articles.summary:
### Impact
The HTML sanitiser did not remove XHTML and XML data URIs. A CMS author could store content that runs JavaScript in the browser of another user who views it.

### Reported by
Jack Wallace from Bastion Security

articles.title: GHSA: Directus: Share update allows reassigning user_created and role
articles.summary:
### Summary

A non-admin user who can update their own shares can reassign a share's creator (`user_created`), `role`, `item`, and `collection` fields after the share is created. The update is authorized against the row as it existed before the change, and the resulting row is never revalidated, so these fields can be set to values the user would not be permitted to assign when creating a share. articles.title: GHSA: mail-parser: One hostile attachment aborts `write_attachments()` and silently drops the rest of the batch
articles.summary:
### Impact

`write_attachments()` called `_safe_attachment_filename()` and `write_sample()` inside its loop
with no guard, so a single crafted attachment raised out of the whole save. Every attachment
**after** the malicious one was silently never written, with no error surfaced to a caller that
catches only `MailParserError`.

That is an evasion primitive as much as an availability bug: a sender

articles.title: GHSA: mail-parser: Uncaught `OverflowError` / `OSError` on an out-of-range `Received` date
articles.summary:
### Impact

A `Received` header whose trailing date carries an out-of-range year, or a timezone offset
large enough to push the timestamp past the int64 epoch range, raises an exception that is
**outside the `MailParser*` hierarchy**. A caller that catches only mail-parser exceptions
does not catch it, and the parse of the entire message is aborted — the same class of issue

articles.title: CVE-2026-93673 — CVSS 4.8
articles.summary: The Zephyr WebSocket client validates the server's handshake response in on_header_value() in subsys/net/lib/websocket/websocket.c. The comparison was performed as strncmp(at, str, length), where length is the length of the value the server sent rather than the length of the expected value, so the check only asked whether the received value was a prefix of the expected base64(SHA-1(key || GUID)).

articles.summary: The Coder VS Code extension opens Coder workspaces in VS Code with a single click. From 0.1.20 until 1.14.6, a malicious repository can provide .vscode/settings.json values for security-sensitive Coder settings because the extension permits workspace and folder scope to override those settings. articles.summary: In Open Object Rexx (ooRexx) before 5.2.0, RXAPI has a heap buffer over-read in a QueueManager DataQueue::addmethod. In particular, the code blindly trusts the message.parameter1 value provided by the client as the size used to fill the data from the queueData heap buffer. articles.title: CVE-2026-130206 — CVSS 5.9
articles.summary: Chyrp Lite (xenocrat/chyrp-lite) contains a missing brute-force protection vulnerability in the main_login() function that allows remote attackers to repeatedly submit login attempts against the admin account without any attempt counter, lockout, delay, or CAPTCHA enforcement. articles.title: CVE-2026-130083 — CVSS 4.9
articles.summary: BookStack before 26.09.2 contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability in the ZIP content importer that allows authenticated users with the Import Content permission to exhaust server storage. Attackers can upload a small ZIP whose data.json references one bundled file many times, causing ZipImportRunner::importAttachment() to write a full copy per reference.

articles.title: CVE-2026-130082 — CVSS 8.8
articles.summary: django-tenants 3.4.8 before 4.0.1 contains an SQL injection vulnerability in its PostgreSQL backend that allows attackers to inject SQL through unescaped tenant schema names. Attackers who can choose or influence a schema name can supply quote characters that are interpolated into SET search_path and CREATE, DROP or ALTER SCHEMA statements, letting them read other tenants' data or run SQL as the a

articles.title: CVE-2026-130081 — CVSS 7.5
articles.summary: B3log Solo through 4.4.0 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to obtain article view passwords by querying the public GET /articles API. The ArticleProcessor.getArticlesByPage handler leaves the articleViewPwd property in JSON responses, letting attackers read passwords for encrypted articles and access their protected content.

articles.title: CVE-2026-130080 — CVSS 6.5
articles.summary: B3log Solo through 4.4.0 contains an SQL injection vulnerability in the console article update API that allows authenticated authors to inject SQL through unvalidated JSON property names. Attackers can send a PUT request to /console/article/ with crafted property names used as UPDATE column names, then read query results back through the updated article.

articles.title: CVE-2026-130079 — CVSS 5.4
articles.summary: B3log Solo through 4.4.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows attackers to inject script by setting a malicious article title rendered without escaping. Attackers can set titles, including via the B3 sync endpoint, so admin/article-pwd.ftl, skin templates, and js/page.js article lists execute script in visitors' and administrators' browsers.

articles.title: CVE-2026-130077 — CVSS 5.8
articles.summary: crw-server before 0.45.1 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to reach internal hosts via caller-controlled proxy and proxy_list fields in /v1/scrape. Attackers can supply proxy entries pointing to loopback, private-network or link-local hosts, bypassing page URL checks to open HTTP-proxy or SOCKS connections internally.

articles.title: CVE-2026-130076 — CVSS 5.8
articles.summary: crw-server before 0.45.1 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to reach internal services by supplying an unvalidated baseUrl to the /v1/scrape endpoint. Attackers can set llmApiKey and request the summary format, making the server POST to loopback or private addresses and use returned warnings as a reachability oracle.

articles.title: CVE-2026-130074 — CVSS 8.1
articles.summary: free5GC WebConsole through 1.4.6 contains an authorization flaw in the ChangePasswordInfo handler that allows authenticated tenant users to change other members' passwords. Attackers can send POST /api/change-password with another tenant member's email and a new password, without the current password, to take over that account.

articles.title: CVE-2026-130073 — CVSS 8.3
articles.summary: CBoard before commit 7bd8180 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows any authenticated user to reach admin functions because AdminController and DashboardController methods bypass AOP role checks. articles.title: CVE-2026-130072 — CVSS 9.1
articles.summary: Cloud Commander (cloudcmd) before 19.21.4 contains an authentication bypass and path traversal vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to rename files by sending PUT /rename requests handled before authentication middleware. Attackers can supply absolute or ../ paths in the from and to arrays to move any file the Node.js process can access outside the configured root, causing data loss

articles.title: CVE-2026-130071 — CVSS 9.8
articles.summary: TridotsTech go1cms master branch through commit 7f68d05 and version-3 branch before commit ead8da3 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in the guest-whitelisted update_doc method that allows unauthenticated attackers to modify any document. Attackers can supply a doctype, name and arbitrary fields that are saved with ignore_permissions=True, altering User records to escalate privileges,

articles.title: CVE-2026-130070 — CVSS 9.1
articles.summary: Ghost by muneeb141 on the main branch from commit c731cdf through commit 672dfec contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the whitelisted ghost.api.ghost.convert_to_real_user method that allows unauthenticated attackers to skip OTP verification by setting the client-supplied bypass_otp parameter. Attackers can obtain a ghost session from the guest-accessible create_ghost_session endpoint

articles.title: CVE-2026-130069 — CVSS 5.0
articles.summary: Frappe Framework before 15.123.0 and 16.x before 16.50.0 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in the frappe.email.email_body.get_email_html method, which lacks role checks. Authenticated users, including portal Website Users, can inject stylesheet link tags into unescaped email templates, causing Premailer to fetch internal or external hosts and return the content.

articles.title: CVE-2026-130068 — CVSS 5.4
articles.summary: Umbraco CMS 17.0.0 before 17.7.1 and 18.0.0 before 18.2.1 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in Management API document version endpoints that skip per-document ContentPermissionByResource checks. Authenticated back-office users restricted to a start node can list and read document versions outside their tree by GUID, exposing unpublished values and altering prevent-cleanup flags.

articles.title: CVE-2026-130067 — CVSS 7.8
articles.summary: 7-Zip File Manager before 26.03 fails to detect archive entry names padded with Unicode space characters, allowing attackers to bypass the deceptive file name warning in CPanel::IsVirus_Message. Attackers can craft archive entries like a PDF name followed by ideographic spaces and .hta to hide the real extension, executing script content via ShellExecuteExW when opened.

articles.title: CVE-2026-130066 — CVSS 6.5
articles.summary: Alinto SOGo before 5.12.13 contains an SQL injection vulnerability in SQLSource contact lookup that allows authenticated users to inject SQL by placing a backslash before a quote in the object name. Attackers can send requests under a SQL-backed address book path on MySQL or MariaDB to perform UNION or boolean-based reads of the user-source table, including password hashes.

articles.title: CVE-2026-130065 — CVSS 5.3
articles.summary: msgpack-c through 7.0.2 contains a heap buffer overflow vulnerability in msgpack_vrefbuffer_migrate() in src/vrefbuffer.c that checks capacity against the source array's end pointer. When migrating between vrefbuffers of unequal size, the realloc is skipped and memcpy() writes iovec entries past the destination array, corrupting adjacent heap memory or crashing the application.

articles.title: CVE-2026-127219 — CVSS 5.3
articles.summary: WPChat plugin for WordPress before 1.4.6 contains a broken access control vulnerability that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to invoke the admin claim-offer action by reusing the publicly exposed wpchat_frontend nonce without any capability check. articles.summary: Wiki.js is an open source wiki app built on Node.js. articles.title: GHSA: mail-parser: Uncaught exceptions and silent header loss in mail-parser on attacker-controlled input
articles.summary:
### Impact

Two effects, sharing the root cause of Advisory 1 — header names chosen by the sender were
resolved through Python attribute lookup and rewritten before lookup.

**Uncaught exceptions.** A crafted message raises an exception that is *outside* the
`MailParser*` hierarchy, so a caller catching only mail-parser exceptions does not catch it
and the worker dies.
